finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/notes/yorkie-note-store.ts::setlocalselection folding into an open batch (activeroot/activepresence path) is untested
evidence: Verified against the supplied full text of `packages/frontend/src/app/notes/yorkie-note-store.test.ts` and `notes-undo-integration.test.ts`: neither calls `setLocalSelection`, and the integration test asserts only text/undo-stack state, never presence. Structurally the folding branch at yorkie-note-store.ts:186-193 cannot be hit through the mounted editor either, because `noteSync.update()` opens and closes `store.batch()` within its own ViewPlugin update, while the only caller of `setLocalSelection` (`remote-selection.ts`'s plugin update) runs as a separate plugin update after `activeRoot` has been reset to null. `remote-selection.test.ts` exercises a stub store, not `YorkieNoteStore`. So the new branch and the "presence never pollutes the undo unit" claim are genuinely unexercised; impact is limited since the branch is defensive and likely unreachable today.
